outcome: Estimated gastric volumes (calculated by gastric antral cross-sectional area and mathematical models)
cohort: The study included 59 fasting term pregnant women (29 diabetic, 30 non-diabetic) scheduled for elective cesarean birth.
finding: Gestational diabetes was not found to be a risk factor for increased residual gastric volume, but BMI was a statistically significant risk factor, with CSA increasing by 0.285 units for every 1 unit increase in BMI.
cross-section timing: Pre-operative, while fasting, before elective cesarean birth
